worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Lz & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 4 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 2 & 0 & -5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 8 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1\cdot (-3)+0\cdot 8+4\cdot 2 \\ 1\cdot (-3)+3\cdot 8+(-2)\cdot 2 \\ 2\cdot (-3)+0\cdot 8+(-5)\cdot 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3+0+8 \\ -3+24-4 \\ -6+0-10\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 17 \\ -16\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
